title: Merely
summary: ME'RELY, adverb Purely; only; solely; thus and no other way; for this and no other purpose. Price not your life for other ends Than merely to oblige your friends.

inlines.v: ME'RELY, adverb Purely; only; solely; thus and no other way; for this and no other purpose. Price not your life for other ends Than merely to oblige your friends.
